project_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings

project_metadata.job_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings
project_metadata.job_description:
We are seeking a Licensed Electrical Professional Engineer (PE) to review and stamp the electrical as‑built drawings for a completed project at a Healthcare System (North Las Vegas, NV).

We need an Electrical PE to provide discipline‑specific concurrence for the electrical modifications.

This is a small‑scope, low‑complexity electrical job.
No load calculations, no panel upgrades, and no redesign are required.

What We Need From You
Review the electrical as‑built sheets (PDF)
Provide PE stamp + signature on the electrical sheets
